diagnosis.subject: A narrow, cobblestone street in an old town at night, leading up towards a large, illuminated castle on the hill.
main_problems: The overall image is too dark, losing detail in the shadows.
The contrast is low and muddy, making the stone textures look flat.
There are blown-out highlights in the sky and on the castle.
The street and building textures lack definition.
The purple lights on the castle are slightly oversaturated and muddy.
